submissions.name: Docs MCP + Chain MCP Agent
submissions.notes:
Sourced Docs MCP explanations were followed by real Chain MCP calls to totalSupply and decimals. Both reads were verified at a pinned block.

Reproduce: see this task README for the exact CLI commands and configuration. The proof page links original MCP transcripts and output files.

Scope: Only whitelisted read-only intents are supported. Same-provider same-block read repetition checks consistency, not independent-provider agreement. Mixed write/read requests and mismatched targets are refused.

submissions.name: Audit-Log Agent
submissions.notes:
The captured report contains 8 unique transactions. Both normal and ERC20 history reached the selected interval start in the indexer. Markdown and CSV exports are included.

Reproduce: see this task README for the exact CLI commands and configuration. The proof page links original MCP transcripts and output files.

Scope: Method labels/selector classification of swaps and contract calls is heuristic. Token events are indexed Transfers. Counts are activity records, with separate unique transaction counts. No USD conversion. A page cap produces an explicitly partial report; indexer completeness is not guaranteed.

submissions.name: Whale-Watching Agent
submissions.notes:
Five configurable public addresses; 4 significant USDC moves matched the configured threshold in a real Chain MCP log scan.

Reproduce: see this task README for the exact CLI commands and configuration. The proof page links original MCP transcripts and output files.

Scope: The demo watchlist was selected from public onchain activity, not the user's wallets. Labels are explicit configuration; unknown addresses remain literal. This command reports a bounded recent range. Long-running cursor monitoring is a separate extension, not claimed here.

submissions.name: Wallet Risk Checker
submissions.notes:
A verified older contract sample scored low; an unverified contract with a high observed failure fraction scored medium. Five signals are evaluated with explicit unknown states.

Reproduce: see this task README for the exact CLI commands and configuration. The proof page links original MCP transcripts and output files.

Scope: Both examples use bounded, partial history. Low means no observed configured flags, not proven safe or clean. An empty flagged list is unknown, not a pass. Only successful approvals sent by the checked owner are sampled; no external threat-intelligence feed is claimed.

submissions.name: Weekly Digest Agent
submissions.notes:
Current seven-day metrics are compared to the preceding seven days, with 3 distinct notable transactions. Two actual worker ticks were captured using an accelerated two-second interval. The production GitHub workflow runs Mondays at 00:00 UTC (07:00 Vietnam) and deploys the refreshed digest page.

Reproduce: see this task README for the exact CLI commands and configuration. The proof page links original MCP transcripts and output files.

Scope: The accelerated demo verifies scheduling, not the passage of an actual week. Hosted starts may be delayed by GitHub. Indexer/page-cap limitations propagate into the digest. A local worker writes local HTML; the included hosted workflow supplies recurring public publication.

submissions.name: Policy Gatekeeper
submissions.notes:
One allowed read-only call and one actual denied configuration for each spend, allowlist and trusted UTC time-window rule. Denied requests did not invoke their action.

Reproduce: see this task README for the exact CLI commands and configuration. The proof page links original MCP transcripts and output files.

Scope: This demo Skill gates read-only eth_call simulations. It is not a production signing gateway. No private key or broadcast method exists. UTC windows use the trusted host clock, not a client-supplied timestamp.

submissions.name: Threshold Guardian
submissions.notes:
Three distinct live signals (native balance, token supply and gas quote) were evaluated. One configurable run fired the token report; another held and did not run the report action.

Reproduce: see this task README for the exact CLI commands and configuration. The proof page links original MCP transcripts and output files.

Scope: Fire performs a read-only report, not a rebalance. Supply and native balance are pinned; the gas quote is current and cannot be pinned by this API.

submissions.name: Dry-Run Executor
submissions.notes:
A successful read-only ERC20 transfer simulation estimated 79757 gas and 797570000000000 wei. An excessive transfer reverted and invoked the executor zero times.

Reproduce: see this task README for the exact CLI commands and configuration. The proof page links original MCP transcripts and output files.

Scope: The successful sender is a public funded EOA used for simulation only; ownership is not claimed. Expected balances assume a standard non-fee ERC20. Gas estimate uses current state while the call/balance reads use a fixed block. Successful execution only prepares an unsigned transaction; actual signing/broadcasting is outside this build.

submissions.name: Skill + Chain MCP Flow
submissions.notes:
A single account/state request loaded the local state-brief Skill, fetched live Chain MCP balance/supply/gas/metadata, and produced a brief from those exact inputs.

Reproduce: see this task README for the exact CLI commands and configuration. The proof page links original MCP transcripts and output files.

Scope: SkillEngine follows the official knowledge-package pattern; these are custom local Skills, not an invented hosted runtime or an Anvita deployment. The native balance and supply snapshot share one block; token metadata/report calls may use a later block and both are shown.

submissions.name: Doc-Grounded Builder Agent
submissions.notes:
Three different supported how-do-I requests were planned with sourced Docs MCP answers, executed through Chain MCP, and verified. An unsupported banana-on-Mars request was refused without a chain action.

Reproduce: see this task README for the exact CLI commands and configuration. The proof page links original MCP transcripts and output files.

Scope: This Hard-task build has a bounded three-intent scope. It does not synthesize arbitrary contract code or deploy contracts. Verification is same-provider consistency, not independent corroboration.
